note: Wooded glacial-moraine park near Forest City with a 15-acre fishing lake and the Dead Man's Lake sphagnum bog. The campground's south row looks down a wooded bank to the east end of the lake. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Hookups changed water/sewer true -> electric 30, water cleared, sewer false (the only full-hookup site is host site H61); sites 65 -> 60 (48 electric + 12 non-electric, to 60 ft, pull-throughs); facilities and booking (100% reservable, 3-month window, 10 pm day-of cutoff) confirmed; fees unchanged (match RA: $10/$14 non-electric). Waterfront not waterfront -> lakeview. PIN ~330 m off. Note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront -> lakeview. ReserveAmerica's own photos of sites 005, 006 and 008 show the 15-acre lake through bare trees below the site. On imagery with RA's GIS points the south row (sites 1-12) sits ~40-50 m above the lake's east end, down a wooded bank: no open apron, so not on-water. The other rows sit farther back. Site 057/058 photos show no water.

HOOKUPS: the one 'Standard Full Hook-Up' site (H061, 20/30/50 A, $18/$34) is the host site ('H = Host site' on the DNR map), though RA sells it. Public sites are 20/30 A electric with 'Full Hookup - no', so electric is 30, sewer false and water cleared (no site attribute for water). The DNR map legend's 'Full Hook-up (20/30-amp)' entry appears to mean the electric sites.
PIN: stored 43.25150,-93.56050 is in woods across the lake, ~330 m SW of the campground. Correct to 43.2539,-93.5583, the centroid of RA's 62 per-site GIS points.
FIT: 37 of 48 electric and 8 of 12 non-electric sites list 23 ft or more, so the $10/$14 non-electric base stands. The shortest sites list 15-20 ft.
SEASON: RA's April 15 - November 15 agrees with the stored (manual) season.
